title: The Black Lotus Vacation Rental
meta_description: The Black Lotus is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionThe Black LotusPt Washington | Days Lane, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights:3 Bedrooms (see “Room Details” for configurations)3 BathroomsSerene backyard on McQuage BayouLarge outdoor wood-burning firepit (firewood not included)On-street public parking for 2 cars or 1 car + boat trailerWaterfront access with nearby boat launch—perfect for kayaks, paddleboards, and small boatsOutdoor gas grillKitchen equipped with refrigerator, freezer, under-counter ice maker, 2 dishwasher drawers, 2-burner hot plate, and Breville Smart OvenSelect events allowed (approval required; see notes below)Overview:Escape to The Black Lotus, a refined waterfront retreat designed by a professional interior designer. Filled with striking art, curated antiques, and upscale finishes, this home blends artistic charm with the natural beauty of coastal Florida.Relax on the screened-in porch, gather around the firepit under the stars, and enjoy breathtaking marsh and bay views. The fully private downstairs level offers three elegant bedrooms and three full bathrooms, with complete separation from the upstairs (homeowner may occasionally be in residence).Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the nearby boat launch and access to Pt Washington State Forest trails for hiking and biking. Iconic Grayton Beach is just a 5-minute drive or 10-minute e-bike ride away, with public parking and a free shuttle to downtown Grayton’s shops, galleries, and renowned dining, including the famous Red Bar.Beach Access:Grayton Beach is approximately 4 miles away (8–10 minute drive). Public parking and free shuttle service are available. Beach vendors offer professional chair setups, or guests may bring their own gear.Golf Carts & E-Bikes:Golf carts are not permitted due to local laws. Electric bikes are a great alternative and can be delivered directly to the home or rented nearby in Grayton Beach.Parking:On-street public parking accommodates two cars or one car + boat trailer.Events:Available for select events with prior homeowner approval. All event coordination is handled exclusively through CC Boone Styled. Event-related costs are additional and not included in the standard rental rate.Policies:No smokingPets not allowed (service animals only; documentation required)Rates exclude taxes and fees50% due at booking; balance due 60 days before arrival5% cancellation fee applies; full refund for cancellations made more than 60 days priorOptional travel insurance availableCheck-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTGuests must be at least 25 years oldExperience laid-back luxury, artistic design, and the tranquility of waterfront living at The Black Lotus.
